title: Zenith Fried Slovakian Nectarine Dumplings
description: A savory Slovakian dish featuring nectarines, fried to a crispy perfection and wrapped in pandan leaves, inspired by the peaceful atmosphere of Buddhist temples.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, potato starch, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add milk and eggs to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a few pieces of diced nectarine in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the nectarine filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Wrap each dumpling in a pandan leaf, making sure to cover the entire dumpling.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully place the dumplings in the hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the dumplings from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fried dumplings hot and enjoy.
